subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should recalling a Feishu source message immediately cancel every active agent and tool run bound to that message, including all broadcast agents?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and technically sound, but terminating already-running tool and agent work is an intentional user-facing channel policy with session-state and delivery consequences.

options.title: Treat recall as cancellation
options.body: Abort every source-bound Feishu dispatch and suppress queued or final replies when the source is recalled.

options.title: Suppress delivery only
options.body: Allow active agent and tool execution to finish but discard queued and final replies after recall.

options.title: Wait for shared policy
options.body: Defer this PR until the broader cross-channel behavior is decided in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55691.

recommendation.title: Treat recall as cancellation
recommendation.body: Abort every source-bound Feishu dispatch and suppress queued or final replies when the source is recalled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to Feishu inbound dispatch, channel policy, recipient sessions, and the central path whose semantics change here.
